events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place over three days in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, three days of peace and music that defined a generation. What's your favourite performance from '69?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have been 91, passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 91. His music still moves the world.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55, was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, passing away six days later.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His powerful lyrics and influence continue to resonate across generations.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84, died in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the memory of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK, featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album. That iconic cover, the timeless tracks... pure genius. Which is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive lead singer and songwriter of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Her unmistakable voice and rock 'n' roll attitude continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that raw energy to the stage. What's your top Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day, we celebrate the anniversary of John Lennon's powerful 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant as ever.

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, a device that revolutionised how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Today marks the anniversary of its release – the device that put a thousand songs in your pocket and changed everything.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the anniversary of 'Dr. No's' premiere in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, which Bond film or track is your ultimate favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder, musician, and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His songs continue to inspire and resonate across the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' groundbreaking 'White Album'. A double LP packed with diverse sounds. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80, passed away in London.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.
